description: Small question set for the multi-modal RAG: 21 questions, one or two per capability, kept small on purpose because every run (and every judge) costs API tokens. Every reference answer was checked against the files in data/. relevant = sources that should be retrieved (file, and page where it matters); expected_numbers = {value, tol}: a number within tol of value must appear in the answer; must_contain = phrases that must appear; should_refuse = the system must decline.
